scope: Theorem 5.1 of the manuscript “A Counterexample to Kaplansky's Direct-Finiteness Conjecture in Characteristic Two” (preprints/A-Counterexample-to-Kaplanskys-Direct-Finiteness-Conjecture-in-Characteristic-Two-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 197 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a97d7915d43b5112), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For all sufficiently large h, for every Q and enumeration as above, there are a set O ⊂ S and a set F of affine lines contained in V = A \ O such that 2Npt D2 ≤ |O| ≤ 7Npt D2 , (5.4) every point of V lies on exactly D members of F, and the bipartite incidence graph of V and F has girth at least 12.
